headline: Colonials Retake Godcrofts Archipelago as Central Battlefields Suffer Heavy Attrition
war_summary: In a dramatic reversal on the eastern seas, Colonial forces have completely overturned previous Warden gains across Godcrofts, bringing all nine strategic island strongholds under their banner following dozens of sharp engagements. Linn of Mercy has similarly unified under Colonial control, with all eleven bases secured despite fierce clashes that claimed over eleven hundred casualties in the past two hours alone. The war's heaviest attrition now grips Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse; Callahan's Passage recorded more than two thousand casualties across the last two hours under firm Warden control, while Weathered Expanse saw Colonials expand their footing to a six-to-three margin amid relentless gunfire. Along the western approaches, Farranac Coast experienced renewed upheaval with five recent base actions leaving one position neutral, while Stlican Shelf remains fiercely split five bases to four after fresh contests at Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. Meanwhile, Stonecradle stays tightly contested at five to four, and Mooring County retains a lone contested stronghold in no-man's-land at The Wind Hills.
